name: Webform Private Elements
description: Admin config to auto-mark chosen Webform element types as "private" by default; enforcement is delegated to Webform core.
project_description:
The webform private elements module allows site administrator to define which webform elements are "private" by default. When these elements are added to a form, the "private" setting is automatically checked. Private elements are used by webform to control additional access checks before showing "private data".

 For example, use this module to define all addresses, phone numbers, and email addresses as "private" by default.
